t: In front of you is a statue of Matthew Flinders, inside Euston station. It was made by the artist Mark Richards. Flinders was a Royal Navy officer, navigator and cartographer, and he led the first inshore circumnavigation of mainland Australia, which was then called New Holland. He is also credited as the first person to use the name Australia for the whole continent, including Van Diemen's Land. He thought it more agreeable to the ear than older names like Terra Australis.
